intro.title: Feel confident talking about cervical screening
intro.description: Practise calling a clinic to learn how to book an appointment for cervical screening and what to prepare beforehand.

privacy.notice: This is a practice session. Do not share personal information or sensitive medical details. The conversation transcript is not saved on this page.

welcome.title: Ready to practise?
welcome.description: Imagine you are calling a clinic to book a cervical screening appointment. Luna will guide you through the practice call step by step.
steps: Check your microphone and find a quiet place.
Listen to the practitioner and respond when prompted.
Review your summary to prepare for your appointment.
welcome.browserNote: Allow your browser to access your microphone when prompted.

complete.title: Practice completed
complete.description: Your practice call has ended. Review your summary to see your answers and what you can prepare before contacting the clinic.

live.ringHelp: Listen to the phone ringing and wait for the call to be answered.
live.speakHelp: Speak clearly when you are ready.
live.speakingHelp: Listen before responding. You can speak when it is your turn.
live.continueHelp: Please wait for the conversation to continue.

transcript.title: Call transcript
transcript.empty: Your conversation will appear here when you start practising.

scope.title: Please note:
scope.description: This is an educational simulation, not a medical service. For medical advice or an actual appointment, contact a clinic or healthcare professional.
